Check the Entries of a lib-* Library

Source: R/rProject-lib-check.R
LibCheck.Rd

Checks every entry file in .setup/latex/bib of a lib-<decade>-<type> project against the house conventions.

Usage

LibCheck(path, root = NULL, error = FALSE)

Arguments

path

Character string. Project path.

root

Character string or NULL. A folder with local clones of the other lib-* projects, to find keys and DOIs used in more than one repository. If NULL, only this project is checked.

error

Logical. If TRUE, stop when there is an ERROR.

Value

Returns a data frame with the columns file, key, severity, check, and message, invisibly.

Details

  • ERROR: the file does not parse or holds more than one entry; the file name is not <repo>-<key>.bib; the key does not follow Family-Family-Family[-etal]-Year[a-z] (three names, then etal, for four or more authors); the key year differs from the date year or lies outside the decade; a required field is missing; a non-ASCII character; an unescaped % in a text field; a key or DOI used twice; biber reports a missing mandatory field.

  • WARNING: an entry type outside the repository's type; a lone suffix (b without a); other biber datamodel warnings.

  • STYLE: not in the house layout (see LibFormat()); \a'-style accents; a page range with one hyphen; a DOI with a prefix; no final newline.

biber's warning that publisher is not an @Article field is the house convention and is not reported.
